name: loreforge
description: LoreForge provides skills, templates, and routing rules for binding-centric workflows over user-owned repositories.

interface.longDescription: LoreForge provides binding-centric workflows for setup, ingest, generic writeback, native review staging, search, lint, and native query/promote while keeping agent-local experience in pamem.
defaultPrompt: Set up a binding before working in a new target repo.
Search configured read roots before ingest or writeback.
Use protocol lint to check binding state and package health.
Use native promote for stable writes on mode=native bindings.
